details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its package.json declares a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs"), and beacon.cjs sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header "x-beacon-package: @ppa-web-components/ppa-searchform". The JSON body contains only install metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the working directory, the npm user the publisher string and the protocol. index.js is a no-op Proxy shim that also triggers the same beacon when the module is required. The package collects no credentials, environment values, tokens or file contents, and performs no other operation. The README states it was published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test and reports only that it was installed.
